description: Call this when you have a project's git repository URL rather than a package name -- a fork, a vendored library, a project with no registry release -- and you are about to depend on it or say whether it is maintained. Your training data has a cutoff, and a repository that looked active in it may have gone quiet since. Pass every repository you are weighing in one call. One already analysed comes back with its risk now. One that is not is analysed, which takes up to a few minutes: if it is not done within the call, the result is "incomplete" with a uuid -- call get_analysis with that uuid to collect it, which is not charged. Calling this tool again instead is charged again.

items.description: A git repository URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo
